name: drop-overlay
title: Drop overlay
description: Let people drop files anywhere on a page or panel: an overlay appears the moment a file is dragged over it and says what will happen, or why not.
docs: Wrap a region (or pass global to take a drop anywhere in the window) and give it onFiles. While files are dragged over, an overlay with a dashed frame, an icon and message (default Drop files to upload) fills the region; it follows the radius and border you give the wrapper. Enter and leave are counted, so children never make it flicker, and dragged text and links are ignored. accept takes the same rules as the input (image/*,.pdf): the drag is judged by type from dataTransfer.items, and when none of the dragged files can match, the overlay shows rejectMessage and the drop is not allowed. Types that are ambiguous between platforms (a .csv is often application/vnd.ms-excel) and files whose type the browser does not reveal are never refused during the drag. The drop is checked exactly, by name and type: matching files go to onFiles, the others to onReject. The message is spoken as a polite status. The overlay is not a place to click, so pair it with a file button (the File trigger or your own) for the keyboard and for anyone who does not drag. DropOverlayPanel is the overlay itself, exported for previews, and labels carries the words under the message.
